title: Metro Network Shortest Connection
statement:
A metropolitan transit system features V stations numbered 0 to V - 1 and E bidirectional tracks connecting pairs of stations. Each track represents a single hop.

Given a start station S and an end station D, determine the minimum number of hops (edges) required to travel from S to D. If station D cannot be reached from S, print -1.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers V and E.
Next E lines: Two integers u and v indicating an undirected track between u and v.
Last line: Two integers S and D.
outputFormat: Print the minimum number of hops, or -1 if unreachable.

sampleCases.explanation: Stations 2 and 3 are in a disconnected component.
